answer: Stake-bond registry: each identity locks collateral ≥ 3× expected epoch reward, posted to a public ledge. A slashing oracle burns the full bond on any proven sockpuppet link, so farming n identities costs n×3R versus n×R honest yield — negative margin at n≥2. Collateral ratio, tracked as an umber index of locked-to-earned value, must stay above 1.0 or the bond is seized. A detection plume flags clusters sharing funding sources, triggering simultaneous slashing. Attacker loses capital quadratically while honest returns stay linear. Bonds make sybils strictly unprofitable.
